main_text.l: {CAP.} XIII. Transluncentes matutino probari censent: anc
si necesse est, in quartam horam; postea vetant. Expe-
rimenta pluribus modis constant: primum pondere, si gra-
viores sentiuntur: post haec corpore; factitiis pustulae in
profundo apparent, scabritia in cute, in capillamento
fulgoris inconstantia & priusquam ad oculos perveniat
Ibidem. Tantaque differentia est, ut aliae ferro scul-
pi non possint, aliae non nisi retuso, verum omnes Ada-
mante. Plurimum vero in his terebrarum proficit

page.notes: The opening word of the first paragraph is printed as "Cap.xiii." in small capitals with the heading mark; the word "Transluncentes" is as printed in the scan (likely "Translucentes"), and "anc" at line end is probably "tamen" or "ante" partly cut off, marked as read. Line ends in "anc" and "Transluncentes" are doubtful. The ERRATA heading is rendered as printed.
